fields.Name: MoreCheese: Score Member Renewal Risk
fields.Description: Scores every Member Profile with the Member Renewal Risk model and writes the result onto the profile (RenewalProbability / RenewalStatus / RenewalScoredAt). Opts in to Predictive Studio auto-train: on a fresh install (or whenever the model has no trained artifact on this server) the first run trains pipeline 'MoreCheese: Member Renewal Risk', publishes the model, points this process and its scoring binding at it, then scores.
